title: Open Household Records Taxonomy
classification_principle: Assign each record one primary category based on the household context that most naturally owns its ongoing meaning. Preserve other relevant contexts as relationships, tags, or references rather than competing primary copies.
retrieval_test: If this record disappeared, which part of household life would notice first?

sensitivity_levels.context_dependent: Sensitivity varies substantially with the specific record and household context.
sensitivity_levels.often_sensitive: This family often contains personal, account, location, ownership, or other information that should be handled deliberately.
sensitivity_levels.highly_sensitive: This family commonly contains identity, health, financial, legal, child, or similarly consequential personal information.

categories.name: Identity & civil status
categories.definition: Records that establish identity or significant personal-status facts.

applicability.when: Use for identity and civil-status records that actually apply to members of the household.

sensitivity.note: Identity documents can expose information that enables impersonation, account recovery, or other misuse if handled poorly.

review_triggers: document loss, theft, replacement, or cancellation

categories.name: Home & property
categories.definition: Records connected to owning, renting, inspecting, improving, repairing, or managing a home or other property.

applicability.when: Use when the household owns, rents, occupies, improves, or is otherwise responsible for a property.

sensitivity.note: Property records can reveal addresses, ownership, financing, access, condition, or security-related details.

review_triggers: move, purchase, sale, or new lease

categories.name: Insurance
categories.definition: Policies, renewals, coverage information, claims, proof of insurance, and insurer correspondence across household insurance needs.

applicability.when: Use for insurance products and claims that apply to the household, its people, property, vehicles, travel, or other insured interests.

sensitivity.note: Insurance records may contain identifying, financial, health, property, beneficiary, claim, or account information.

review_triggers: major household, property, vehicle, health, or travel change

categories.name: Tax
categories.definition: Returns, assessments, slips, receipts, and supporting records retained or used for tax purposes.

applicability.when: Use for records whose primary household purpose is tax filing, support, assessment, payment, or correspondence.

sensitivity.note: Tax records commonly combine identity, income, account, address, dependant, and other sensitive personal information.

review_triggers: retention requirement reached under the applicable authority

categories.name: Legal & estate
categories.definition: Legal instruments, court records, estate documents, representation documents, consent documents, and agreements whose primary purpose is legal authority or legal rights and obligations.

applicability.when: Use only for legal or estate records that actually apply to the people and circumstances in the household.

sensitivity.note: These records may affect legal authority, beneficiaries, dependants, property, finances, care, or other consequential rights and responsibilities.

review_triggers: new, amended, revoked, or replaced instrument
marriage, separation, birth, death, or dependant change
representative, executor, guardian, or beneficiary change
move to a different legal jurisdiction

categories.name: Emergency & continuity
categories.definition: Plans, contacts, accessible reference information, care instructions, and other material intended to help appropriate people act when normal household routines are disrupted.

applicability.when: Use for information deliberately prepared for emergency response, temporary incapacity, absence, or household continuity.

sensitivity.note: Emergency material may combine contact, health, identity, location, dependant, pet, access, or account-reference information and should expose only what is useful for the intended purpose.

review_triggers: change in who is expected to help

categories.name: Financial
categories.definition: Banking, borrowing, investments, financing, statements, and other household financial records that do not belong more naturally under a more specific family.

applicability.when: Use for financial accounts, obligations, assets, and transactions relevant to the household.

sensitivity.note: Financial records can contain account identifiers, balances, transactions, borrowing information, personal identifiers, and other high-impact information.

categories.name: Vehicles & transportation
categories.definition: Registration, purchase, financing, inspection, maintenance, service, and other records tied to vehicles or recurring transportation assets.

applicability.when: Use when the household owns, finances, leases, maintains, or is otherwise responsible for a vehicle or recurring transportation asset.

sensitivity.note: Vehicle records may contain registration, ownership, financing, address, location, identifier, or insurance information.

categories.name: Health & care
categories.definition: Records used to understand, document, or coordinate health, medication, treatment, benefits, and care.

applicability.when: Use for health and care information that the household legitimately maintains or needs to coordinate.

sensitivity.note: Health and care information is deeply personal and may be subject to additional legal or professional handling requirements depending on context and jurisdiction.

categories.name: Household assets, receipts & warranties
categories.definition: Purchase, ownership, warranty, manual, serial-number, repair, and supporting evidence connected to significant household belongings and equipment.

applicability.when: Use for belongings or equipment where purchase, ownership, operation, service, warranty, or replacement information is worth retaining.

sensitivity.note: Many asset records are low-risk, but ownership evidence, serial numbers, addresses, purchase values, account details, or security-related equipment can increase sensitivity.

review_triggers: serial number or ownership evidence captured

categories.name: Education & children
categories.definition: School, childcare, activity, enrolment, permission, progress, and other records primarily connected to a child's education or organized activities.

applicability.when: Use only where children, dependants, education, childcare, or youth activities are relevant to the household.

sensitivity.note: Records involving children or dependants may contain identity, location, school, custody, health, contact, schedule, or other sensitive information.

review_triggers: child ages out or record loses practical relevance

categories.name: Employment & income
categories.definition: Employment, compensation, benefits, pension, credential, and other records primarily connected to work and household income.

applicability.when: Use for employment, contracting, benefits, pension, credential, or income records that apply to household members.

sensitivity.note: Employment and income records can expose compensation, identifiers, benefits, banking, tax, health, or other personal information.

categories.name: Pets
categories.definition: Veterinary, vaccination, registration, insurance, medication, adoption, licence, and care records associated with household animals.

applicability.when: Use where the household has animals whose health, ownership, care, registration, or insurance information is worth maintaining.

sensitivity.note: Pet records are often low-risk, but owner contact details, addresses, payment information, access arrangements, or insurance information can increase sensitivity.

categories.name: Travel
categories.definition: Trip-specific bookings, visas, itineraries, insurance, confirmations, rentals, and supporting travel information.

applicability.when: Use for information whose primary purpose is a specific trip or travel arrangement.

sensitivity.note: Travel records can reveal identity details, travel dates, locations, booking references, contact information, payment details, and periods when a home may be unoccupied.

categories.name: Household services & utilities
categories.definition: Utility, communications, security, and recurring home-service records connected to operating a household or property.

applicability.when: Use for recurring utility, communications, security, or home-service relationships that apply to the household.

sensitivity.note: Service records can reveal address, account, contact, usage, access, security-system, payment, or property information.
